draft_metadata.filename_title: 本氏烟叶绿体区室化紫杉烷前体合成代谢工程
draft_metadata.classification_reason: 研究核心是在 Nicotiana benthamiana 中将 TS、T5αH、CPR 三个紫杉醇途径酶通过叶绿体区室化与 MEP 通路前体池增强，从内源异戊二烯单元实现 taxadiene 与 taxadiene-5α-ol 的从头合成；属于以植物为宿主的天然产物异源生物合成与细胞区室化代谢工程范畴。category 设为 biosynthesis；同时因研究突出对 T5αH/CPR 的亚细胞定位改造（P450-CPR 嵌合体转运肽融合），附加 enzyme_engineering 作为相关分类。
source_gaps: 原 PDF 仅含主文（页 1–12），不含 Supplementary Information；正文中对 Supplementary Fig. 1（NTS1-T2 PCR 验证）、Fig. 2（TS 提取标品共洗脱）、Fig. 3、5、7（taxadiene-5α-ol、OCT、iso-OCT 的 GC-MS/NMR 验证）、Fig. 12（taxadiene-5α,10β-diol 候选峰）、Fig. 24–25 与 28–30（HMGR/tHMGR 过表达验证）、Fig. 27（fosmidomycin/lovastatin 表型及产量）等 SI 图的描述仅依据正文结论性引用；Supplementary Tables 1、4–6（克隆引物）、Table 2（亚细胞定位预测）、Table 3（qRT-PCR 查询序列）同理。
Figure 4b 与 Figure 6c 中 OCT (3)、iso-OCT (4) 柱的精确 μg g⁻¹ FW 数值及误差未在正文中给出，仅以 taxadiene-5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT 比值 (1:5:1.5, p5；1:4:1.6, p7) 形式报告；图注仅给出 'n.d.' 标签，无定量数字。
Figure 5a qRT-PCR 各基因柱的具体倍数变化值在正文中仅以 'gradually decreased'、'increased significantly' 等定性描述给出，未对每个基因（DXS、DXR、IspD、IspE、IspF、IspG、IspH、HMGS、HMGR、MK、PK、PMD、IDI、GGPPS）列出具体相对表达数值。
Figure 5b 中 DXR+TS、IspH+TS、IDI+TS、HMGR+TS 组合的精确柱形值未在正文给出，仅以 'only slight improvements' 描述（p7）；图注亦无对应数值标签。
T5αH 经 taxadiene epoxide 中间体再分解为 taxadiene-5α-ol / OCT / iso-OCT 的机制在本研究中以 proposal 形式归入文献 62 (Edgar et al., ACS Chem. Biol. 2016) 并非本研究直接捕获中间体验证 (p9)；cause-and-effect 属于外推。
为保留全部图版与图注，截图采用原文整页。

verified_claims.claim: Abstract 核心数字：taxadiene 56.6 μg g⁻¹ FW、taxadiene-5α-ol 1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW (committed Taxol intermediates)。
verified_claims.evidence: produce taxadiene and taxadiene-5α-ol, the committed taxol intermediates, at 56.6 μg g⁻¹ FW and 1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW, respectively

verified_claims.claim: Taxadiene 时程：2 dpi ≈0.8 μg g⁻¹ FW → 4 dpi 5.6±1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW → 5 dpi 15.7±4.7 μg g⁻¹ FW。
verified_claims.evidence: taxa-4(5),11(12)-diene initially accumulated at 2 dpi (about 0.8 μg g⁻¹ FW), significantly increased to almost 5.6 ± 1.3 μg g⁻¹ at 4 dpi, and to 15.7 ± 4.7 μg g⁻¹ at 5 dpi

verified_claims.claim: 叶绿体形式 TS-tp(TS)/trT5αH/trCPR：taxadiene 9.9 μg g⁻¹ FW (≈2.0× vs 胞质)、taxadiene-5α-ol 0.90 μg g⁻¹ FW (≈4.3× vs 胞质 0.21)。
verified_claims.evidence: an increase in the amount of taxadiene to 9.9 μg g⁻¹ FW (about 2.0-fold higher than engineering in the cytoplasm), and a remarkable increase in taxadiene-5α-ol to 0.90 μg g⁻¹ FW (almost 4.3-fold increase as compared to yields from cytoplasmic engineering)

verified_claims.claim: 胞质形式 trTS-trT5αH/trCPR：仅 0.21 μg g⁻¹ FW taxadiene-5α-ol。
verified_claims.evidence: such truncations did not significantly increase taxadiene levels, but slightly enabled accumulation of taxadiene-5α-ol at a low level of 0.21 μg g⁻¹ FW

verified_claims.claim: 前体增强筛选：DXS+TS 45.9 μg g⁻¹ FW (>8×)、GGPPS+TS 24.5 μg g⁻¹ FW (4×)、HMGR+TS 未提升 taxadiene；DXS+GGPPS+TS 组合 56.6±3.2 μg g⁻¹ FW (~10×)。
verified_claims.evidence: DXS increased taxadiene production by more than 8-folds, up to 45.9 μg g⁻¹ FW... Co-expression of GGPPS also increased taxadiene production by 4-folds (24.5 μg g⁻¹ FW)... the taxadiene yield was up to 56.6 ± 3.2 μg g⁻¹ FW, about 10-fold increase as compared to the single TS engineered plants

verified_claims.claim: 前体通路药理抑制 (NTS1-T2 稳定株)：fosmidomycin 150 μM 完全阻断；lovastatin 10 μM 减产 40.1% (15.7±3.2 → 9.7±2.4 μg g⁻¹ FW)。
verified_claims.evidence: the NTS1-T2 control lines could produce taxadiene at levels of 15.7 ± 3.2 μg g⁻¹ FW while the MVA-inhibited plants decreased taxadiene production by 40.1% to the level of 9.7 ± 2.4 μg g⁻¹ FW. Inhibition of the MEP pathway by fosmidomycin totally suppressed taxadiene biosynthesis in NTS1-T2 plants.

verified_claims.claim: 整合策略：TS-tp(TS)/trT5αH/trCPR + DXS-GGPPS 共浸润使 taxadiene-5α-ol 提升至 1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW；taxadiene-5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT = 1:4:1.6 (叶绿体单独工程为 1:5:1.5)。
verified_claims.evidence: There was an improvement of taxadiene-5α-ol accumulation to 1.3 μg g⁻¹ FW when chloroplast engineering was combined with enhancement of precursor supply... The ratio of taxadiene-5α-ol:OCT:iso-OCT in chloroplast-engineered lines (1:4:1.6) was nearly similar to that in cytosolic engineered-plants

verified_claims.claim: TS 旁路异构体：verticillene 1.4±0.2 μg g⁻¹ FW (2.5%)、taxa-4(20),11(12)-diene 6.9±1.8 μg g⁻¹ FW (12.2%)、taxa-3(4),11(12)-diene 5.2±0.9 μg g⁻¹ FW (9.2%)；与 Williams 2000 ref 45 分布 76.1/12.2/9.2/2.5% 一致。
verified_claims.evidence: verticillene (1.4 ± 0.2 μg g⁻¹ FW, 2.5%), taxa-4(20),11 (12)-diene (6.9 ± 1.8 μg g⁻¹ FW, 12.2%), and taxa-3(4),11(12)-diene (5.2 ± 0.9 μg g⁻¹ FW, 9.2%), consistent with a prior study
